cases.description: A newly created Position has both entry and exit trades as null, therefore isNew() should return true.
A Position with a non‑null entry trade (created via operate(...) or reflection) but a null exit trade is not new; isNew() must return false.
A Position with a null entry trade but a non‑null exit trade (simulated by setting exit via reflection) is not new; isNew() must return false.
A Position where both entry and exit trades are non‑null (e.g., after opening and then closing a trade) is not new; isNew() must return false.
